engines.label: Gemini
engines.note: Grounded answers; footnote link block since Jul 2026

causes.label: AIO displacement
causes.title: The answer replaced the click
causes.body: You still rank. An AI answer sits above you and cites someone else. Fixed with citable content, not with SEO.

causes.label: Ranking decline
causes.title: You actually slipped
causes.body: A plain position loss, hiding inside the same falling line. Your existing SEO playbook applies — and only here.

causes.label: Technical decay
causes.title: Engines can't read you
causes.body: Broken pages, blocked crawlers, missing structure. Cheap to fix, invisible until something measures it.

causes.label: Other / unexplained
causes.title: Honestly labeled
causes.body: What the model can't attribute stays striped and named "unexplained" — never silently folded into a cause.

limitations.label: Personalization
limitations.body: A logged-in user with chat history may get a different answer. We measure the unpersonalized baseline — the answer a stranger gets.

limitations.label: Geography
limitations.body: Default is US-region. Answers differ by market; additional regions are a Scale feature, not a silent average.

limitations.label: Model drift
limitations.body: Engines change weights without notice. A sudden industry-wide shift shows as a flagged discontinuity on your chart, not as your failure.

limitations.label: Sampling error
limitations.body: Three runs bound, not eliminate, variance. Charts carry confidence bands; week-over-week moves inside the band are labeled as noise.
